claim_or_assumption: The package supports a bounded simulation-first safety argument for structured-road following under the tested perception-uncertainty protocols.
boundary: The argument is simulation-first and does not prove zero real-world risk, unrestricted deployment, or completed physical validation.
next_required_evidence: Independent raw-run reproduction, DOI-backed repository, ROS2/HIL timing, and supervised robot trials.

claim_or_assumption: The evaluation ODD and dataset split are explicit enough to prevent route/map leakage overclaims.
boundary: Split checks prove file-level separation only; Town10HD/Leaderboard remains stress evidence, not unrestricted map-level deployment proof.
next_required_evidence: External held-out maps and raw route manifests deposited with DOI metadata.

claim_or_assumption: The main discriminating benefit is improved target consistency under ambiguity, not universal mission-completion superiority.
boundary: Route-level completion can remain equal under conservative MPC; target-consistency metrics carry the central comparative claim.
next_required_evidence: Additional ambiguous multi-agent scenarios with raw logs and independent reruns.

claim_or_assumption: Zero observed collisions are reported as finite-sample observations with a rule-of-three boundary.
boundary: A finite simulation protocol cannot certify true collision probability as zero.
next_required_evidence: Larger raw reruns, independent scenario sampling, and physical safety-supervisor logs.

claim_or_assumption: Fail-safe stops are counted as task failures, making the safety-versus-availability trade-off visible.
boundary: Conservatism can reduce availability; the current paper does not solve all stopping or semantic rule-compliance failures.
next_required_evidence: Risk-aware planner tuning and real-world operator-reviewed availability metrics.

claim_or_assumption: NIS/POP diagnostics expose uncertainty response under noise and outlier perturbations.
boundary: NIS diagnostics are not real-sensor calibration and do not prove ROS2 runtime behavior.
next_required_evidence: Sensor-calibrated residual distributions and ROS2 bagged NIS traces.

claim_or_assumption: Detector/timing, raw-sensor-like, ambiguity, boundary, and NIS diagnostic layers reduce single-protocol dependence.
boundary: Layered stress coverage remains scripted simulation evidence, not photorealistic raw-sensor validation.
next_required_evidence: Raw-sensor replay, weather/lighting sweeps, and independent stress-protocol reruns.

claim_or_assumption: ROS2 interface, CI, software-smoke, HIL-manifest, and gate audits prepare the system for supervised real-robot validation.
boundary: Static and desktop checks do not prove colcon build/test, live ros2 launch, rosbag timing, or robot motion.
next_required_evidence: Executed colcon logs, launch logs, bags, HIL replay summaries, and operator-signed run manifests.

claim_or_assumption: Runtime telemetry schema, manifest, audit, and parser dry-run make future HIL/robot timing evidence immediately auditable.
boundary: Telemetry readiness and synthetic parser QA do not prove live ROS2 timing, embedded feasibility, or physical robot motion.
next_required_evidence: Filled runtime telemetry CSVs, rosbag metadata, topic-hz logs, system-load logs, and incident reports.

claim_or_assumption: Figure/table QA, source-data provenance, reproducibility capsule, and local deposit metadata control package drift.
boundary: Local provenance is not a DOI-backed repository and does not replace independent raw-data reproduction.
next_required_evidence: Public repository DOI/accession, licence, reviewer link, and raw-run reproduction instructions.

claim_or_assumption: The manuscript and audit reports explicitly block physical-validation, zero-risk, and deployment-safety overclaims.
boundary: Lexical and artifact-level boundary checks do not replace expert review.
next_required_evidence: Reviewer-facing response updates after raw reruns, ROS2/HIL logs, DOI deposit, and robot trials.

claim_or_assumption: The remaining gap is external execution evidence rather than missing local pre-real-robot package structure.
boundary: The package is not complete for a physical-validation claim.
next_required_evidence: Run colcon build/test, ros2 launch, HIL replay, runtime telemetry extraction, physical trials, and DOI deposit.
